description: This file is a build recipe (likely a BitBake recipe or similar) for building Vim, an enhanced version of the Unix text editor Vi. It includes metadata, dependencies, configuration, build, and installation instructions for the build system.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares the build configuration for Vim by initializing autotools in the source directory.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Performs the compilation of Vim, initializing locale files before calling autotools for compilation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built Vim binaries and runtime files, setting permissions, installing example config, and creating alternatives for 'vi' and 'vim'.
